_comment: BRAND VOICE lane: clone a real reference from ~3 seconds of audio, then speak any of the ten supported languages in it. Record the owner or presenter once in English and generate the French from the same clone - no second session, no second performer, one voice across both languages. That cross-lingual transfer is the reason this model displaced Chatterbox as the default cloning lane.
_ref_audio: Supply ref_audio by uploading the reference with the job (worker-comfyui accepts {"images":[{"name":"ref.wav","image":"<base64>"}]} - the key says images but it writes any file to ComfyUI's input dir) and pointing a LoadAudio node at that filename, wired into ref_audio below. ref_text is optional but raises fidelity noticeably: give it the exact transcript of the reference clip.
_ref_hygiene: Reference audio must be clean speech. Music, room tone or a noise floor under the reference transfers into every generation, and unlike VibeVoice's background-music quirk there is no documented mitigation beyond a better reference. 3-10 seconds, one speaker, no processing, no compression artefacts.
_consent: A cloned voice of a REAL, IDENTIFIABLE person is the case that attracts obligations - EU AI Act Art. 50(4) deepfake disclosure, and Quebec biometric-data provisions if voiceprints are retained. A wholly synthetic voice attracts neither. Get written consent on file before cloning anyone, and prefer a preset or designed voice where the brand does not need a specific human. See DECISIONS.md Part 1.
_x_vector_only: x_vector_only=true conditions on speaker identity alone and discards the reference's prosody. Use it when the reference is expressive in a way you do not want copied (a shouted clip, a laughing clip) and you only want the timbre.

inputs.target_text: Our crews lay your floor in two days, not two weeks.
